program.title: BSc in Physics
uncertain: total_required_credits (106.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The program has a mandatory International Research Enrichment (IRE) Track plus three mutually exclusive Options (Computational Physics with AI, Honors Physics, Physics and Mathematics). The sum double-counts shared courses: PHYS 3031 / MATH 4023 / MATH 4052 appear in both the IRE Track and the Honors Physics Option; PHYS 3034 / PHYS 4051 appear in the IRE Track, Honors Physics Option and Physics and Mathematics Option; PHYS 2010 appears in both the IRE Track and Honors Physics Option electives. A realistic computation is the core (groups 1-17 = 56 credits) plus the mandatory IRE Track (groups 18-20 = 13 credits) = ~69 credits, plus an optional Option.
Several blocks allow alternative course choices with credit ranges (3-4, 4-6, 3-6), so actual credits may differ from the lower-bound calculation.
Remarks in the PDF note that PHYS 4813 was last offered in 2021-22 and deleted subsequently; it is kept in the list as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 PHYS (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
